01.title: The Story Begins – Devgarh Village | Vanraksha Episode 1 Gameplay
01.desc:
Episode 1 – The Forgotten Forest begins in Devgarh village. The forest animals flee, the river turns black, and young Veer sets out to find his missing father.

🎬 In this video (Episode 1 – The Forgotten Forest):
• The opening story of Devgarh village
• Veer meets the village Elder
• The first steps into the jungle

🌳 About the game
Vanraksha – the Spirit of the Forest is an Indian pixel-art action adventure. Young Veer from Devgarh protects the sacred jungle, searches for his missing father and fights poachers and dark spirits.

⭐ Features
✔ 3 full episodes – one big Indian folklore story
✔ Play as a team: Veer, Bijli the white tiger cub and Chhaya the shadow warrior
✔ Sword combos, rolls, double jumps and wall jumps
✔ Puzzles: pressure plates, giant eagles, vine bridges, light & shadow worlds
✔ Epic bosses: the Corrupted Guardian, Durjan Singh, Jalmala and Tamas
✔ Original raag-style music · English and Hindi
✔ Touch controls made for phones
